coverage: extension-check resolves every aria-labelledby ID against popup elements and strips nested markup before requiring non-empty text.
A labelledby reference takes precedence over an otherwise valid aria-label; missing targets or empty text fail closed.
Offline self-tests cover valid label references, missing targets, empty-text targets and existing aria-label cases; the real popup passes at two named controls.

limitations: The gate is a source-level accessibility regression check, not a browser UI Automation runtime audit.
No physical-audio, driver install/load, HLK, Microsoft signing or vendor ASIO control is claimed.
